summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Stock Management System. 25/25 pytest backend tests PASSED. Frontend login, dashboard, navigation, and all pages verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown - consider FastAPI lifespan
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback could cause issue in prod (browser rejects credentialed requests with wildcard). Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS env var.
bulk-upload: 'nan' string coercion is fragile; prefer pd.notna checks. Also missing overall size/row-limit validation.
Stock in/out validate quantity > 0 after location lookup; pydantic Field(gt=0) would be cleaner and 422 semantically correct.
No pagination on /api/stock-master (to_list 1000) or /api/transactions - may be slow at scale.
Password policy not enforced on register (min length).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created: 4 stock_master items (PN_<tag>_A ACME/BOSCH, PN_<tag>_B ACME, PN_<tag>_C ACME), 1 godown, 1 rack, 1 box, 1 stock-in (qty 10), 1 stock-out (qty 3). Balance = 7 (verified). Dashboard counters updated correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test data uses RUN_TAG uuid prefix (PN_<tag>_*) so re-running backend tests creates fresh items. Admin is re-seeded/password-reset on every backend startup. All 25 pytest tests green including auth (register/login/me/401), stock-master CRUD + uniqueness (part_no+make), lookup/makes, lookup/item, bulk CSV upload, godown/rack/box hierarchy with filters, stock-in validation (invalid item, qty<=0), stock-out insufficient balance, stock-balance aggregation, low-stock threshold, transactions filter by type, dashboard stats. Frontend sidebar has all 8 links (Dashboard, Stock Master, Locations, Stock In, Stock Out, Stock Balance, Transactions, Low Stock). Login → / (dashboard) redirect works. Data-testid attributes are mostly missing on UI elements but role/text selectors work.
